name: SI:7
summary: From Goldshire, promising young rogues are sent to report to Renzik "The Shiv" in Stormwind. There, you enter Master Mathias Shaw's service, where covert work awaits.

sections.title: A Summons to Old Town
sections.body: At the Lion's Pride Inn, Keryn Sylvius watches Goldshire's local recruits. You prove cunning and capable against the growing Defias threat, and Sylvius passes along a message from headquarters. Report to Renzik "The Shiv" without delay. You leave Elwynn's fields for Stormwind's covert ranks.

sections.title: Stormwind's Hidden Eyes
sections.body:
Behind an unassuming barracks in Old Town, Stormwind's hidden agency keeps its headquarters. Master Mathias Shaw commands its work across the kingdom and beyond. The agency handles covert operations, reconnaissance, and assassination.

Renzik "The Shiv" is Shaw's sharp-tongued second-in-command. He assesses promising agents, then sends them into dangerous work beyond the reach of the kingdom's formal military.

faq.q: Who sends me to report to SI:7?
faq.answer: Keryn Sylvius, the rogue trainer at the Lion's Pride Inn in Goldshire, sends you to report to SI:7. After you prove your skill in the field, Sylvius gives you orders to report to Stormwind headquarters.

Renzik "The Shiv" is a goblin operative and SI:7's second-in-command under Master Mathias Shaw. He evaluates field agents and coordinates covert intelligence assignments from the headquarters in Old Town.

SI:7, or Stormwind Intelligence, handles covert espionage, reconnaissance, and assassination for the Kingdom of Stormwind. Led by Mathias Shaw, its operatives gather intelligence on threats the kingdom's guards and soldiers cannot address.

faq.q: Where is the SI:7 headquarters located?
faq.answer: SI:7's headquarters is in eastern Old Town in Stormwind City. The agency works from a fortified guildhall and training barracks set away from the main streets.

faq.q: What happens after reporting to Renzik?
faq.answer: After you report to Renzik, he tests your readiness. Then he sends you beyond the city walls to meet an operative stationed in Redridge.

faq.q: Why does Keryn Sylvius call me 'fish'?
faq.answer: “Fish” is slang for an untested novice or new recruit. Agency operatives use colorful, abrasive nicknames to keep rookies grounded until they prove themselves on real assignments.

angles.text: As a rogue, this summons takes you from local work into service as an operative for Stormwind's official intelligence branch.
As an Alliance member, you can look to SI:7 for dangerous espionage beyond the reach of regular marshals and infantry.
